# Security Policy

Thank you for taking the time to report potential security issues responsibly.
This project is maintained on a best-effort basis, so response and resolution
times may vary.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please report it through
the project's private GitHub Security Advisories page:

**https://github.com/rtsworks/lintra/security/advisories**

You will need a GitHub account to submit a report.

When reporting, please include (if possible):
- A clear description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Any proof of concept (optional)
- Potential impact (if known)

Please **do not file public GitHub issues** for security reports.

## Scope

The following are considered security issues:
- Vulnerabilities that allow unauthorized access, data exposure, or code execution
- Significant privilege escalation or bypass of security controls
- Issues that meaningfully impact confidentiality, integrity, or availability

The following are **not** considered security issues:
- Bugs with no security impact
- Missing features or general usability problems
- Issues in third-party dependencies not maintained by this project
- Social engineering or physical attacks

## Disclosure

Once a report is received, I will review it as time permits.
If the issue is confirmed, I will work on a fix or mitigation when available.

You will be notified once:
- The issue is confirmed
- A fix or workaround is published
- A coordinated disclosure date is agreed upon (if applicable)

I cannot promise specific response times or release schedules, but I appreciate
all responsible disclosure efforts.

## Supported Versions

This project follows a **best-effort support model**.
Typically:
- The latest release is maintained when possible
- Older releases may not receive security updates

Thank you for helping improve the security and reliability of this project.
